title: Weihnachten in der Kinder- und Jugendliteratur. Literaturwissenschaftliche Analysen, didaktische und methodische Perspektiven
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Christmas is one of the few motifs in children’s and young adult literature (CYAL) that can look back on a comparably long tradition. Whether in canonical classics, contemporary picture books and children’s novels, audio dramas, film adaptations, or nineteenth-century young adult literature, Christmas narratives explore traditions and values, representations of family life, and interpersonal conflicts. This volume brings together literary analyses of Christmas representations with perspectives from cultural studies and educational research. At its core lies the question of what potential Christmas literature holds for classroom teaching, particularly at the primary school level. Rather than serving merely as a seasonal stopgap before the holidays, Christmas literature is examined as a space for teaching and learning in which social, cultural, and literary issues can be explored in age-appropriate and engaging ways.By adopting an interdisciplinary perspective on the theme of “Christmas in Children’s and Young Adult Literature,” this volume addresses a significant gap in existing scholarship while offering valuable impulses for educational practice.
